description: Defines data structures related to NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) configuration and assistance information, including classes for assistance info, cell configuration, and overall NTN configuration manager.

classes.name: ntn_assistance_info
classes.description: Contains NTN assistance information such as SIB19 fields, ephemeris data, timing, and coverage enhancements.

classes.name: ntn_cell_config
classes.description: Represents configuration for an NTN cell, including its global ID, scheduling info, and assistance info.

classes.name: ntn_configuration_manager_config
classes.description: Holds a collection of NTN cell configurations for managing NTN settings.
